claim.text: This is the biggest decline, think of it, in recorded history—the lowest number in over 125 years.
claim.context: And last year the murder rate saw its single largest decline in recorded history. || This is the biggest decline, think of it, in recorded history—the lowest number in over 125 years. || Year 1900, in fact substantially before my wonderful father—I had a wonderful father, Fred—before he was born, substantially before he was born.

row.reasoning: contemporary CCJ-based reporting supported that 2025 had about a 21% homicide decline, the largest one-year drop on record, and the lowest homicide rate since records back to 1900

evidence.snippet: [2026-01-22] CCJ report: 2025 homicide rate on pace for largest single-year drop and lowest rate in records back to 1900.
[2026-01-01] CCJ year‑end 2025 analysis projects ~21% homicide drop and a ~4.0/100k national rate—lowest since 1900 if FBI confirms.
[2026-01-22] CBS reports CCJ finding: ~21% drop in murders in 2025, the largest one‑year decline and potentially lowest rate since 1900.
[2025-08-05] FBI/CDE 2024 official quick‑stats: 16,935 murders, 5.0 per 100,000 in 2024 (baseline for evaluating 2025 projection).
[2026-01-01] NCHS Data Brief (Mortality in the U.S., 2024) documents homicide declines in 2024 and their contribution to increased life expectancy.
[2026-02-24] Official White House release explicitly states the murder rate fell to its lowest in 125 years and claims the largest single‑year drop in recorded history.
[2025-08-05] Official FBI 2024 data (murder -14.9%); supports record-decline framing but is prior year, not the 125-year claim.
[2026-01-23] NYT: 2025 homicide rate lowest in 125 years, largest single-year drop per CCJ.
